description: ANGKOR EYES test suites: unit, integration (Testcontainers), E2E (Playwright), load (k6), security (Semgrep), AI eval (Promptfoo).
name: angkor-eyes-tests

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:security
scripts.test:e2e:bot: echo 'Bot E2E harness not landed yet — see tests/e2e/bot.test-outline.md' && exit 1
scripts.test:eval: node -e "try{require.resolve('promptfoo')}catch(e){console.error('promptfoo is not installed (optional dep: npm install -D promptfoo@^0.110.0). Its better-sqlite3 native build fails in some sandboxes.');process.exit(1)}" && promptfoo eval --config ai-eval/promptfoo-config.yaml
